title: Clinical Microbiology
description: Culture media and AST products from Liofilchem for pathogen isolation, identification, and resistance testing. We supply referral labs, hospital microbiology departments, and public health laboratories across India with cold-chain delivery.

title: Molecular Diagnostics
description: PCR kits from Sacace and StripAssay genotyping from ViennaLab for infectious disease testing, pharmacogenetics, and hereditary screening. Available to diagnostic labs and research institutions across India.

title: Food Safety & Testing
description: PhageGuard bacteriophage solutions from Micreos for targeted Listeria and Salmonella control in food processing. Relevant for Indian food manufacturers, exporters, and testing laboratories working to international food safety standards.

title: IVD Raw Materials
description: Antibodies, antigens, enzymes, and assay optimization reagents from Medix Biochemica and Candor Bioscience. For Indian IVD manufacturers and R&D teams building or improving diagnostic assays.
